description:
£150 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this three-bedroom student property on the popular Cavendish Road.

The property offers three spacious double bedrooms, a separate kitchen, a comfortable lounge leading out to a lovely garden, and a dedicated dining area, providing plenty of space for both relaxing and socialising. On-street parking is also available.

Ideally located for easy access to Newcastle City Centre, the property is well positioned for students attending Newcastle and Northumbria Universities, as well as those needing convenient access to the Royal Victoria Infirmary (RVI) and other local amenities.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today on 0191 212 0400.
